about: Ghent's tram lines, for `node tools/tramlines.mjs ghent`. Each line runs past its places ([lat, lon], in order) over the map's tram tracks; the stops are the tram halts it passes. The lines end where the map's tracks do (lines 1 and 2 run on to Evergem, Van Beverenplein and Melle, line 4 to Moscou, off the map). The gaps are streets whose tracks were taken out of OpenStreetMap during the works round Gent-Sint-Pieters (2026): the trams run along them again here.

gaps.about: Sint-Pieters to the Korenmarkt: Koningin Elisabethlaan, Kortrijksesteenweg, Kortrijksepoortstraat, Nederkouter, Veldstraat (line 1)
Sint-Pieters to the Groot-Brittanniëlaan: Koning Albertlaan and the Koning Albertbrug (line 4)
